checks: Default check path is read-only and rejects the pending template before artifacts are accepted. Build requires an explicit input manifest binding exact kernel/PVR, raw storage evidence, GPU acceptance and pinned GstGL package.

Frozen source-v10 size/SHA and finalize marker are checked before rootfs cloning. Rootfs state/output names are distinct v11 paths and creation rejects existing image/state and symbolic links. Mount changes occur in a private mount namespace; cleanup restores policy and unmounts bind/proc/sys/dev/run/rootfs.

Installed kernel package/PVR/archive contents are pinned by the reviewed v24 updater input validator. Only exact local kernel and GstGL debs are installed, with service starts inhibited; no apt upgrade or Mutter trial payload is imported.

Credential file hashes are compared privately in shell variables, never included in output manifests. GDM config/PAM hashes are preserved and AutomaticLoginEnable must be false. Existing GPU profile guard is reused with the exact new release and acceptance artifacts.

Explicit recovery copies retain v16 kernel/initrd/config/System.map plus the accepted topology DTB and v16 modules; no v16 payload is removed. Recovery selects boot files through the compiled command, and does not claim automatic recovery after a booted kernel hangs.

New U-Boot is built in an isolated path using frozen CPU-D source/patch inputs. The resulting config must differ from frozen CPU-D only in CONFIG_BOOTCOMMAND, including explicit HS200200 and HS400200 options. A mere Linux alias or armbianEnv change is not substituted for persistent U-Boot parameters.

Compiled boot command uses an explicit t736_recovery=1 branch selecting v16 paths and baseline arguments; default branch selects installed v24 aliases and exact opt-in arguments. Hush branch and ext4load failure guards are present; booti-return/failure is not presented as automatic fallback.

Packer preserves pinned SPL v4, stage64 and TF-A bytes, bounds U-Boot payload/package geometry, checks input hashes and embedded rootfs manifest, refuses existing output files and verifies packed region hashes/GPT. No board or raw-device operation exists.
